text: PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 13:1 and 13:2 of Block 02, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 420066, situated in the Village of Kausigamuwa, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 610 Kausigamuwa in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Rideegama, in the District of Kurunegala, in the Province of North West, referred to in Notice No calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette 2369/18 of 31st January, 2022 in terms of Section 55 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
